cases.sentence: Господня земля и все, что наполняет ___.
cases.translation: The earth is the Lord's and all that fills it.
cases.explain: The verb наполняет (fill) with an object takes the accusative, here using genitive possessive.

cases.sentence: Мир и все, что живет в ___.
cases.translation: The world and all those who dwell in it.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Кто взойдет на гору ___ и встанет на святом месте его?
cases.translation: Who may ascend to the Lord's hill and stand in his holy place?
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession with the noun гора (hill).

cases.sentence: Тот, чьи руки чисты и чье сердце ___.
cases.translation: He who has clean hands and a pure heart.
cases.explain: The predicate adjective agrees with the nominative subject сердце (heart).

cases.sentence: Он получит от Господа благословение и оправдание от Бога, ___ своего.
cases.translation: He shall receive a blessing from the Lord and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
cases.explain: The genitive case indicates possession or relation as 'Savior' of the speaker.

cases.sentence: Врата, поднимите свои верхи, поднимите с древней ___, чтобы вошел царь славы.
cases.translation: Lift up your heads, you gates; and be lifted up, you everlasting doors.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with/from) governing 'old doors' takes the genitive case.

cases.translation: Who is the King of glory?
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses the quality or characteristic of the king.

cases.sentence: Господь крепкий и сильный, Господь сильный в ___.
cases.translation: The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Господня земля и все, что наполняет её, мир и все, что живет в нём.
reading.question: To whom does the earth and all it contains belong?
options: To the people who live in it
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Господня земля' (The Lord's earth).

reading.ru: Ведь Он поставил её на морях и утвердил на водах.
reading.question: How did the Lord establish the earth?
options: By the strength of his hands
reading.explain: The text states 'поставил её на морях и утвердил на водах' (set it on seas and established on waters).

reading.ru: Кто взойдет на гору Господню, кто встанет на святом месте его?
reading.question: Who may ascend to the Lord's holy place?
options: Those with pure hands and hearts
reading.correct: Those with pure hands and hearts
reading.explain: The following verses specify 'тот, чьи руки чисты и чье сердце непорочное' (he with clean hands and pure heart).

reading.ru: Врата, поднимите свои верхи, поднимите с древней двери, чтобы вошел царь славы.
reading.question: Who is being called to enter, and what is happening?
options: A king of a foreign nation comes to worship
The King of glory is entering and the gates are told to open
A great army approaches the city
The people are celebrating a victory
reading.correct: The King of glory is entering and the gates are told to open
reading.explain: The gates are commanded to lift up so that the 'царь славы' (King of glory) may enter.

reading.ru: Кто он, этот царь славы? Господь крепкий и сильный, Господь сильный в битвах.
reading.question: Who is identified as the King of glory?
options: The Lord, mighty and strong in battle
reading.correct: The Lord, mighty and strong in battle
reading.explain: The text explicitly identifies the King of glory as 'Господь крепкий и сильный.'

reading.question: What titles are given to God?
options: Lord of the Earth and Lord of the People
Lord of Hosts and King of Glory
Lord of Heaven and Master of Nations
reading.correct: Lord of Hosts and King of Glory
reading.explain: The text identifies God as 'Господь сил' (Lord of Hosts) and 'Царь славы' (King of glory).
